claim_en: THE AGE LADDER. Valid at two hairs, admitted at twenty; the service census; liable only for service; Aaron himself; passing blemish.
THE FIRST ROW. Blind, lame, sunken-nosed, dislocated — each a class head with amplified members.
THE FRACTURE ROW. Bent and twisted; joined fingers to the joint fit, below unfit.
THE EYE AND SKIN ROW. Giben, dak, tevallul, the positions, garav, yalefet, the three-way testicle reading — with Onkelos ruling R. Yishmael's arm.
THE DIFFERENCE TABLE. Man and beast with opposite signs; the Kushite class; the three beast-unfits fit in man; passed blemish fit.
THE BLEMISHED EAT. Most holy and holy; even in division against the tevul yom.
THE ENTRY HIERARCHY. Priests, Levites, Israelites, impure, blemished; served = invalid with the death-vs-warning dispute; the warning graph.
